positions.as_written: Localise an accessory posteromedial portal with a needle under vision every time.
Repair sutures should pass through the capsular tissue carrying the perimeniscal plexus, because that tissue is the healing source.
Portal placement should follow the imaging.
Make the anteromedial portal with a needle first, so the trajectory is checked before the skin is cut.
Plan portals and the need for an accessory portal before starting, from the imaging.
